content:
maria: Quick q — planning office hours for SI SimLab onboarding + hands-on cert practice next Tue. Goal: let SIs bring their HW images and marketplace tile, test end-to-end deploy & run cert tests. RSVP here: https://cal.com/redwood/simlab-practice :calendar:

aj: Nice. What's the scope? full deploy? just marketplace listing + run sample prompts?

maria: Full e2e but focused on marketplace + packaging + runbook. We'll have 2 tracks: HW imaging & marketplace tile. 45m each, 15m Qs.

aj: Can we get a checklist to share ahead?

maria: Yep — draft below. Please flag missing items. We'll post to SI enablement repo after sync.

Checklist:
- Pre-reqs: vendor account, SSH creds, GPU image (Ubuntu20.04), model artifact (.pt/.gguf), KMS keys
- Marketplace tile: manifest v2, pricing metadata, sample deploy script
- Run cert: load test script, sample prompt set (100 prompts), accuracy threshold 0.9
- Network: port 8080 open, healthcheck path /ready
- Admin: support contact + license file

suresh: For cert rubric: we use latency < 120ms p50 and quality > 0.9 against eval set. We should let SIs run quantized and full-precision variants. Also allow fallback to hosted model for smoke tests.

evan: Marketplace flow: steps are (1) register partner tile, (2) upload bundle, (3) run marketplace CI, (4) sign legal. I can attach script snippet:
```
# upload
curl -X POST -F file=@tile.zip https://marketplace.redwood.ai/api/v1/tiles -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

claire: I'm happy to run the practice cert station. I can take 2pm PT slot. Need someone for HW troubleshooting.

aj: I'll take HW troubleshooter slot. +1 on running certs with both quantized and fp32.

maria: Cool. Ops-bot can create calendar and post meeting notes.

ops-bot: Created event: SimLab SI Practice - Tue 2pm PT. Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/abc123. Reminder set 24h before.

maria: +1 — we should also capture packaging templates. Putting starter manifest here:
```
name: si-simlab
version: 0.1.0
bundle: tile.zip
entrypoint: run.sh
```
Share any sample tiles you want us to test.

evan: Also add a note: artifacts must be signed. Use `rwood-sign`:
```
rwood-sign tile.zip --key /keys/partner.kms
```

claire: Will prep sample prompts and a short scoring notebook. Anything else?

suresh: Test data must be sanitized. Don't include PII. Also capture metric baseline to avoid regression noise.

maria: Great. I'll post final checklist + Zoom + collab doc by Fri. Thanks everyone :pray:
